from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party named in the judgment."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role (e.g. 上诉人，被上诉人，申请人)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Represents a litigation fee entry."""
    level: str | None = Field(description="Instance level (e.g. 一审，二审)")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Fee amount and unit")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Party responsible for the fee")

class Outcome(BaseModel):
    """Represents the court's ruling."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="Full text description of the ruling")
    outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of outcome (e.g. 驳回上诉，维持原判，驳回申诉，改判)")

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Represents case identification metadata."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Case number cited in the document")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="Legal cause of the dispute")
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of procedure (e.g. 二审，再审)")

class UniqueDetail(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific detail that could uniquely identify the document."""
    content: str = Field(description="The specific detail content")
    detail_type: str | None = Field(description="Category of detail (e.g. 金额，地址，份额)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema aggregating all extracted fields from a single document."""
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of litigation fee details")
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = Field(description="List of court outcome descriptions")
    case_info: list[CaseInfo] = Field(description="List of case metadata")
    unique_details: list[UniqueDetail] = Field(description="List of specific identifying details")
